catalysts.headline: Confirmed: board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.075/share (declared 2026-11-03), payable 2026-12-10 to shareholders of record as of 2026-11-25. This is the fourth consecutive quarter at the same $0.075 rate (prior declarations: 2026-02-11, 2026-04-27, 2026-07-17), i.e. a routine, recurring dividend -- not a special/one-off payout. Not unusual for this company: Solstice is a profitable, cash-generating former-Honeywell specialty/advanced-materials industrial spinoff, and regular dividends plus an active buyback are consistent with that profile rather than anomalous.
